traceability.notes: Story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented. The require-test-traceability rule exposes configuration options for test auto-fix, wires them into the rule logic, and delegates to helper functions that (1) insert a file-level @supports placeholder JSDoc with clear TODO guidance when annotations are missing, and (2) safely normalize malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in test names for recognized patterns (spacing, underscores, lowercase, parentheses) without inventing new IDs. Tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts explicitly exercise each requirement (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE), verifying both validation and auto-fix behavior. All tests pass under Jest. User documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md documents these auto-fix capabilities and configuration, including the placeholder template format. All acceptance criteria and Definition of Done items for this story are satisfied based on concrete implementation and test evidence.
